+def _unit_price(payload) -> float:
+    """Extract the unit price from a pricing-service response.
+
+    The pricing service does not always spell the field the same way
+    (``unit_price`` scalar, a nested ``price`` object, or a ``*_cents``
+    integer), so probe the known shapes instead of assuming one key.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="malformed pricing response")
+    for key in ("unit_price", "unitPrice", "price", "amount"):
+        value = payload.get(key)
+        if isinstance(value, bool):
+            continue
+        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+            return float(value)
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            for inner in ("unit_price", "unit", "amount", "value"):
+                nested = value.get(inner)
+                if isinstance(nested, bool):
+                    continue
+                if isinstance(nested, (int, float)):
+                    return float(nested)
+    for key in ("unit_price_cents", "price_cents", "amount_cents"):
+        value = payload.get(key)
+        if isinstance(value, bool):
+            continue
+        if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+            return float(value) / 100.0
+    raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="malformed pricing response")
+
